n1=(length(p1)%2)+5

ascii4: procedure
 parse arg n
 s=right(d2x(n),4,'0')
 out=''
 do i=1 to 4
  p=pos(substr(s,i,1),'0123456789ABCDEF')-1
  if p<10 then out=out||d2x(48+p,2)
  else out=out||d2x(55+p,2)
 end
 return out

files.M10ESTRS.EXEC:
/* M10E large pkt-line bounded-fragmentation stress. */
address command
say 'M10E TEST 1: initialize bounded side-band parser'
'EXEC GIT10BF INIT'
if rc\=0 then exit rc
/* Maximum normal pkt-line: ffff total bytes, 65530 payload bytes. */
total=65535
payload=total-5
hdr='66666666'
'EXEC GIT10BF FEED' left(hdr,2)
if rc\=0 then exit rc
'EXEC GIT10BF FEED' substr(hdr,3,4)
if rc\=0 then exit rc
'EXEC GIT10BF FEED' substr(hdr,7)||'02'
if rc\=0 then exit rc
say 'M10E TEST 2: stream 65530 channel-2 bytes in small fragments'
chunk=copies('41',31)
leftb=payload
do while leftb>0
 n=leftb
 if n>31 then n=31
 'EXEC GIT10BF FEED' left(chunk,n*2)
 if rc\=0 then exit rc
 leftb=leftb-n
end
say 'M10E TEST 3: complete parser without retaining pkt payload'
'EXEC GIT10BF FINAL'
if rc\=0 then exit rc
say 'M10E LARGE PKT-LINE BOUNDED STRESS TEST PASSED'
exit 0
files.M11ATCP.EXEC:
/* M11A native CMS TCP connect/send/bounded-receive probe. */
parse upper arg host port
if host='' then host='EXAMPLE.COM'
if port='' then port=80
say 'M11A TEST 1: initialize REXX/SOCKETS'
r=Socket('Initialize','M11ATCP')
say r
parse var r rc rest
if rc\=0 then exit 8
say 'M11A TEST 2: resolve IPv4 host' host
r=Socket('GetHostByName',host)
say r
parse var r rc addrs
if rc\=0 then call fail
ip=word(addrs,1)
if ip='' then call fail
say 'IPV4 ADDRESS' ip
say 'M11A TEST 3: create TCP socket'
r=Socket('Socket')
say r
parse var r rc s
if rc\=0 then call fail
say 'M11A TEST 4: enable ASCII translation'
r=Socket('SetSockOpt',s,'SOL_SOCKET','SO_ASCII','ON')
say r
parse var r rc rest
if rc\=0 then call closefail
say 'M11A TEST 5: connect' ip port
r=Socket('Connect',s,'AF_INET' port ip)
say r
parse var r rc rest
if rc\=0 then call closefail
req='GET / HTTP/1.0'||d2c(13)||d2c(10)
req=req||'Host: '||host||d2c(13)||d2c(10)
req=req||'Connection: close'||d2c(13)||d2c(10)||d2c(13)||d2c(10)
say 'M11A TEST 6: send HTTP request'
r=Socket('Send',s,req)
say r
parse var r rc sent
if rc\=0 then call closefail
if sent\=length(req) then call closefail
say 'M11A TEST 7: bounded receive'
total=0
do forever
 r=Socket('Recv',s,256)
 parse var r rc got data
 if rc\=0 then call closefail
 if got=0 then leave
 if got>256 then call closefail
 total=total+got
 if total>1048576 then call closefail
end
say 'RECEIVED BYTES' total
r=Socket('Close',s)
say r
call term
if total=0 then exit 8
say 'M11A NATIVE TCP BOUNDED RECEIVE TEST PASSED'
exit 0
closefail:
 call Socket 'Close',s
fail:
 call term
 exit 8
term:
 r=Socket('Terminate')
 return

files.M12HADV.EXEC:
/* M12H validate live Git smart-HTTP advertisement body. */
address command
say 'M12H TEST 1: read bounded discovery body'
'STATE M11BODY DATA A'
if rc\=0 then exit 8
drop b.
'EXECIO 1 DISKR M11BODY DATA A 1 (STEM B. FINIS'
if rc\=0 | b.0\=1 then exit 8
hex=translate(strip(b.1))
if length(hex)<8 | length(hex)//2\=0 then exit 8
if verify(hex,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then exit 8
if length(hex)>128 then exit 8
/* GIT11HTP stores each bounded body piece as one record. */
say 'FIRST BODY BYTES' left(hex,64)
/* GitHub HTTP/1.1 currently uses chunked transfer coding here. */
crlf='0D0A'
p=pos(crlf,hex)
if p=0 | p>17 then do
 say 'M12H: missing bounded HTTP chunk-size line'
 exit 8
end
chunk=left(hex,p-1)
if chunk='' | verify(chunk,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 then exit 8
body=substr(hex,p+4)
if left(body,8)\='30303165' then do
 say 'M12H: unexpected first Git pkt-line length'
 exit 8
end
want='2320736572766963653D6769742D75706C6F61642D7061636B0A'
if left(substr(body,9),length(want))\=translate(want) then do
 say 'M12H: missing git-upload-pack service announcement'
 exit 8
end
say 'HTTP CHUNK SIZE' chunk
say 'M12H GIT UPLOAD-PACK ADVERTISEMENT PREFIX PASSED'
exit 0
files.M12ICHNK.EXEC:
/* M12I replay captured GitHub chunked body through decoder. */
address command
say 'M12I TEST 1: initialize bounded chunk decoder'
'EXEC GIT12CHK INIT FILE'
if rc\=0 then do
 say 'M12I: INIT failed RC' rc
 exit rc
end
'STATE M11BODY DATA A'
if rc\=0 then exit 8
drop b.
i=1
do forever
 'EXECIO 1 DISKR M11BODY DATA A' i '(STEM B. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 & rc\=2 then do
  say 'M12I: input read failed record' i 'RC' rc
  exit 8
 end
 if b.0=0 then leave
 if b.0\=1 then exit 8
 h=strip(b.1)
 if h='' | length(h)//2\=0 then exit 8
 if length(h)>128 then exit 8
 'EXEC GIT12CHK FEED' h
 if rc\=0 then do
  say 'M12I: decoder failed record' i 'RC' rc
  exit rc
 end
 i=i+1
 drop b.
end
'TYPE M12CMETA DATA A'
'EXEC GIT12CHK FINAL'
if rc\=0 then do
 say 'M12I: FINAL failed RC' rc
 exit rc
end
say 'M12I TEST 2: validate decoded Git advertisement'
drop d.
'EXECIO 1 DISKR M12BODY DATA A 1 (STEM D. FINIS'
if rc\=0 | d.0\=1 then exit 8
h=translate(strip(d.1))
want='303031652320736572766963653D6769742D75706C6F61642D7061636B0A'
if left(h,length(want))\=want then exit 8
say 'DECODED PREFIX' left(h,64)
say 'M12I BOUNDED HTTP CHUNK DECODER TEST PASSED'
exit 0

files.M13PSTG.EXEC:
/* M13P bounded staging regression, uses a synthetic PACK buffer. */
address command
'EXEC GITPBUF INIT'
if rc \= 0 then exit rc
part = '000102030405060708090A0B0C0D0E0F'
do i = 1 to 5
 'EXEC GITPBUF APPEND' part
 if rc \= 0 then exit rc
end
'EXEC GITPBUF FINAL'
if rc \= 0 then exit rc
'EXEC GITNSTG STAGE 60 16'
if rc \= 0 | queued() < 2 then exit 8
parse pull bytes
parse pull records
if bytes \= 16 | records \= 1 then exit 8
drop r.
'EXECIO 1 DISKR GITNSTG DATA A 1 (STEM R. FINIS'
if rc \= 0 | r.0 \= 1 then exit 8
if strip(r.1) \= '0C0D0E0F000102030405060708090A0B' then exit 8
/* Multi-record staging preserves every 64-byte boundary. */
'EXEC GITNSTG STAGE 0 80'
if rc \= 0 | queued() < 2 then exit 8
parse pull bytes
parse pull records
if bytes \= 80 | records \= 2 then exit 8
drop r.
'EXECIO 2 DISKR GITNSTG DATA A 1 (STEM R. FINIS'
if rc \= 0 | r.0 \= 2 then exit 8
if strip(r.1) \= copies(part,4) then exit 8
if strip(r.2) \= part then exit 8
'EXEC GITNSTG STAGE 76 16'
if rc \= 0 | queued() < 2 then exit 8
parse pull bytes
parse pull records
if bytes \= 4 | records \= 1 then exit 8
drop r.
'EXECIO 1 DISKR GITNSTG DATA A 1 (STEM R. FINIS'
if rc \= 0 | r.0 \= 1 then exit 8
if strip(r.1) \= '0C0D0E0F' then exit 8
'EXEC GITNSTG STAGE 80 16'
